items.justification: Secure setup guidance and transparency about data handling pursue different objectives.
Hardware memory protection and asset disposal at transfer of ownership are unrelated controls.
Documenting sensing capabilities and restricting inter-system permissions share no objective.
Key uniqueness is unrelated to re-testing after a major version change.
User control over update installation differs from contingency planning for when updates cannot be supplied at all.
Examining telemetry for anomalies and protecting training data from access are different controls.
A runtime input control and a pre-release testing duty do not combine into one nameable control.
Both protect data assets from unauthorized access; A through transport encryption, B through evaluation of the access control framework.
Publishing an end-of-support rationale is unrelated to incident support duties.
Runtime input validation and pre-release security assessment pursue different objectives.
Both protect sensitive data from unauthorized access; A security parameters crossing a network interface, B training and test data at rest.
Both require security-relevant product documentation; A setup guidance for users, B scope, limitations and guardrails in the system document.
B's awareness duty names latest vulnerabilities and mitigations, the same subject A requires be monitored and rectified.
Verifying a delivered update is unrelated to testing systems before release.
Development processes and user-facing guidance pursue different objectives.
Automatic update activation is a device mechanism; threat modelling is an analysis process with a different objective.
B addresses exactly the case A carves out: A mandates a secure update mechanism unless constraints prevent it, B mandates contingency plans when updates cannot be provided.
Update verification and assurance over external risk owners share no objective.
Communications cryptography and secure coding training are unrelated obligations.
Runtime input validation and pre-deployment testing pursue different objectives.
Testing before release and remediating what is found after it are distinct stages of one defect management process.
Detecting security-relevant change in operation and acting on it in a bounded time are the detection and response halves of one control.
Both preserve user agency over updates being applied; A through enable, disable and postpone controls, B through advance notification.
Key lifecycle management and least-privilege permissions between systems are unrelated controls.
Recording justifications for unmet recommendations is unrelated to pre-release security testing.
Acting on reported vulnerabilities and proactively modelling threats are distinct inputs to one risk management process.
Both protect an externally reachable interface from malicious input; A by validating it, B by rate-limiting and constraining its use.
Both keep a system secure when normal remediation is unavailable; A by recovering to a known good state, B by documented contingency plans.
Publishing the support position and publishing the disclosure policy are distinct commitments making a supplier's security posture public.
Encrypting security parameters in transit is unrelated to risk assessment of external model components.
Having a secure update mechanism is unrelated to threat modelling triggered by configuration changes.
Runtime input validation and pre-deployment testing pursue different objectives.
Both apply minimization to unnecessary capability; A disables unused interfaces, B requires the risk of superfluous model functionality to be managed.
Verifying an update artefact is unrelated to pre-release testing of the system.
Timely remediation and staff threat awareness training are different obligations on different parties.
Checking for available updates is unrelated to monitoring model behaviour drift.
Vulnerability remediation timelines and asset tracking processes share no objective.
Update activation and recovery is unrelated to sanitisation of training data and inputs.
Key uniqueness and documentation content requirements share no objective.
Input validation is a technical control; documentation content is a disclosure duty.
